verdict.rationale: Render's docs include a dedicated 'Rollbacks' section, so rollback of deployed services is a documented capability. The pack contains only that heading, with no detail on how rollbacks work. Missing for 10: evidence of a one-click rollback action, evidence that any previous deploy (not just the last) can be targeted, descriptive first-party documentation of the rollback flow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
